text.p: The Perkin-Elmer Corp on Wednesday said it had acquired privately held GenScope Inc in a move that should give it the ability to reduce the time and cost of bringing products to market.
GenScope has improved a DNA fingerprinting technology called AFLP that offers advantages over other techniques, Perkin-Elmer said in a statement.
With the technology, Perkin-Elmer's Applied Biosystems division plans to provide drug research companies with the capability of enhancing genomics-based drug discovery.
"We are building a new generation of technologies that will be needed to realize full value of the information in genomic databases," said Tony White, chief executive.
Genomics is the process of building genetic databases and using the information to understand how genes function in living cells.
